title: IntelliJ shortcuts commonly used in day-to-day work
answer: On the default Windows/Linux IntelliJ keymap, shortcuts I commonly use include Ctrl+N for Go to Class, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N for Go to Symbol, Ctrl+Shift+F for Find in Files, Ctrl+P for Parameter Info, Ctrl+Space for code completion, Alt+Enter for intention actions, Shift+F6 for Rename, Ctrl+Alt+O for Optimize Imports, and Ctrl+Alt+L for Reformat Code. I use them because they map directly to common development tasks: navigation, searching, understanding APIs, editing safely, refactoring, and cleanup. The exact keystrokes can vary with the operating system and selected keymap, so I treat the active IntelliJ keymap as the source of truth.

steps.title: Jump to a class — Ctrl+N
steps.question: Go to Class searches directly by type name, which makes class-level navigation scale better as the project grows. A large Java project may contain hundreds of classes across many packages. Why is Ctrl+N a shortcut worth using repeatedly instead of navigating the package tree every time?
steps.why: Go to Class searches directly by type name, which makes class-level navigation scale better as the project grows.
steps.why_te: Ee IntelliJ action target code ni fast ga reach cheyyadaniki help chestundi. Large Java project lo chala classes untayi. Ctrl+N class name nundi direct ga search chestundi kabatti package tree repeatedly expand cheyyalsina avasaram taggutundi.

steps.title: Jump to any symbol — Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N
steps.question: Symbol search works across members rather than only filenames or class names, so it helps when your memory starts from behavior instead of location. Sometimes you know a method or field name but not the class that contains it. Why is Go to Symbol useful in that situation?
steps.why: Symbol search works across members rather than only filenames or class names, so it helps when your memory starts from behavior instead of location.
steps.why_te: Ee IntelliJ action target code ni fast ga reach cheyyadaniki help chestundi. Method leda field peru telisi class peru teliyakapoina Go to Symbol project-wide members ni search chestundi. Location kanna behavior gurthunte idi useful.

steps.title: Search project text — Ctrl+Shift+F
steps.question: Find in Files searches project text across files and is ideal for configuration values, messages, SQL fragments, and code patterns. Navigation shortcuts work best when you know a symbol, but sometimes you only remember a string, property, or fragment of code. Why is Ctrl+Shift+F useful then?
steps.why: Find in Files searches project text across files and is ideal for configuration values, messages, SQL fragments, and code patterns.
steps.why_te: Ee IntelliJ action target code ni fast ga reach cheyyadaniki help chestundi. Symbol exact ga teliyakapoina string, property leda code fragment gurthunte Ctrl+Shift+F project files anni search chestundi.

steps.title: Show parameter information — Ctrl+P
steps.question: Parameter Info shows the expected method signature at the call site so you can choose arguments without leaving the editor. Overloaded methods can have several argument combinations. Why is Ctrl+P useful while writing a method call? The Show parameter information — Ctrl+P action exposes the relevant IntelliJ state directly, so the question stays tied to observable project behavior rather than generic interview wording.
steps.why: Parameter Info shows the expected method signature at the call site so you can choose arguments without leaving the editor.
steps.why_te: IntelliJ current code context batti useful information chupistundi. Overloaded method call rasetappudu Ctrl+P expected parameter signatures ni current place lo chupistundi. Documentation kosam flow break cheyyalsina avasaram taggutundi.

steps.title: Invoke code completion — Ctrl+Space
steps.question: Code completion uses the typed project model to suggest relevant symbols, reducing memorization and typing mistakes. A productive IDE should help you discover valid members and APIs from the current type context. Why is Ctrl+Space a frequently used editing shortcut?
steps.why: Code completion uses the typed project model to suggest relevant symbols, reducing memorization and typing mistakes.
steps.why_te: IntelliJ current code context batti useful information chupistundi. Ctrl+Space typed project context nundi relevant members mariyu APIs suggest chestundi. Memorization burden mariyu typing mistakes taggutayi.

steps.title: Open context actions — Alt+Enter
steps.question: Many IDE actions are context-specific—imports, quick fixes, inspections, and transformations—so the best option depends on the exact caret location. Why does Alt+Enter remain useful even for experienced developers who already know Java syntax well? The Open context actions — Alt+Enter action exposes the relevant IntelliJ state directly, so the question stays tied to observable project behavior rather than generic interview wording.
steps.why: Many IDE actions are context-specific—imports, quick fixes, inspections, and transformations—so the best option depends on the exact caret location.
steps.why_te: IntelliJ current code context batti useful information chupistundi. Experienced developer ki kuda Alt+Enter useful endukante imports, quick fixes, inspections mariyu transformations current caret context batti marutayi.

steps.title: Use safe Rename — Shift+F6
steps.question: Rename is a semantic refactoring that uses IntelliJ's symbol model to identify related references before applying a change. Changing a Java symbol by raw text replacement can miss references or change unrelated text. Why is Shift+F6 safer for renaming code symbols?
steps.why: Rename is a semantic refactoring that uses IntelliJ's symbol model to identify related references before applying a change.
steps.why_te: Ikkada code lo required change chestunnam. Shift+F6 raw text replacement kaadu. IntelliJ symbol model use chesi related references ni identify chese code meaning based refactoring.

data.note: Demonstration only; no AeroTopo production symbol is changed.

steps.title: Optimize imports — Ctrl+Alt+O
steps.question: Optimize Imports removes unnecessary imports and normalizes the import section using IDE knowledge of the current file. Java files accumulate unused or disordered imports as code changes. Why is Ctrl+Alt+O a useful cleanup shortcut in normal development? The action keeps the discussion tied to src/main/java/com/aerotopo/AeroTopoApplication.java so the answer can be read against a real project artifact instead of a detached example.
steps.why: Optimize Imports removes unnecessary imports and normalizes the import section using IDE knowledge of the current file.
steps.why_te: Ikkada code lo required change chestunnam. Code change ayyaka unused imports accumulate avvachu. Ctrl+Alt+O unnecessary imports ni remove chesi import section ni clean ga maintain chestundi.

steps.title: Reformat code — Ctrl+Alt+L
steps.question: Reformat Code applies the configured code style consistently, reducing manual formatting differences between developers. Consistent formatting helps reviews focus on logic rather than whitespace. Why is Ctrl+Alt+L commonly used before finishing an edit? The action keeps the discussion tied to src/main/java/com/aerotopo/AeroTopoApplication.java so the answer can be read against a real project artifact instead of a detached example.
steps.why: Reformat Code applies the configured code style consistently, reducing manual formatting differences between developers.
steps.why_te: Ikkada code lo required change chestunnam. Ctrl+Alt+L configured code style ni consistent ga apply chestundi. Review lo whitespace differences kanna actual logic meeda focus cheyyadaniki help chestundi.
